summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a small LaunchDarkly TypeScript type-generator CLI, but its `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and then uses that freshly fetched runtime to execute a bundled ~727 KB sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`), inline string-lookup objects, and shuffled string arrays driven by a rotator (`WV8StW`). A type-generator CLI has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque obfuscated payload executed at install time. This matches the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: on `npm install`, arbitrary obfuscated code runs on the installer's machine under a downloaded alien runtime, independent of the advertised CLI purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
